mechanism_narrative: FGFR1-IGF1R forced-proximity novokine with GS_med linker biases signaling by enabling transphosphorylation between FGFR1 and IGF1R kinase domains, creating novel phosphotyrosine docking sites that recruit SHC1-GRB2-SOS (MAPK/ERK) and IRS1-PI3K-AKT (PI3K/AKT/mTOR) adaptor complexes. The ~353 aa ECD asymmetry (FGFR1 ECD=353 aa vs IGF1R alpha-chain=706 aa) creates a tilted co-clustering geometry that sterically excludes RASA1 (RasGAP), preventing negative feedback on RAS signaling. PLCG1 remains CIS-phosphorylated but is not uniquely activated by forced proximity. The biased output shifts aged muscle toward a younger transcriptional phenotype by upregulating proliferation/survival genes (MYC, CCND1, DUSP6, ETV4) and downregulating senescence/inflammatory markers (TXNIP, IL32, S100A4, LGALS3).
